# Device samples

The project owner contributed these Supernote N6 (Nomad) device samples, format 20260016, under the project's [MIT licence](../../../LICENSE). The samples are anonymised. Generated content replaces the file and page identifiers, link targets, imported template, cover and handwritten stroke in the PDF mark.

- `epub-n6-20260016.mark` exercises a sparse EPUB annotation on document page 22 with a cleared drawing layer.
- `layers-dense-n6-20260016.note` exercises dense ink, layer stacking and a hidden layer with a stored bitmap. Two generated zigzags replace the owner's handwritten signature strokes on the main layer.
- `pdf-highlights-n6-20260016.mark` holds a generated wave, two highlights and an underline with paired sheet and PDF coordinates.
- `picture-links-cover-n6-20260016.note` exercises an image cover, an imported template, a keyword, and links to a document and another page.
- `textbox-links-n6-20260016.note` exercises three Russian text boxes of different sizes, a heading, an internal page link and a web link.

## Additional PDF overlay samples

`pdf-ink-highlights-tall-n6-20260016.mark` was exported from a Nomad N6,
1404 × 1872 sheet pixels, format `SN_FILE_VER_20260016`. Its sheet is document
page 2 with two paired highlights. The source page is 522 × 756 points.

`pdf-ink-highlights-n5-20260016.mark` was exported from a Manta N5,
1920 × 2560 sheet pixels, format `SN_FILE_VER_20260016`. Its sheet is document
page 3 with two highlights (seven rectangle pairs) and one keyword. The source
MediaBox is 549 × 684 points and its CropBox is [9 9 549 675], 540 × 666
points.

The owner contributed these two annotation fixtures under the same MIT licence. The source books
belong to other authors and are not distributed. Tests generate blank PDFs
with matching geometry and independent document-coordinate markers.
